text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Science Teaching and Learning Syllabus, Primary Three to Six, Standard / Foundation (implementation from the 2023 Primary Three cohort; cover: Updated Jan 2026). Human System (Respiratory and circulatory systems), P5 Standard, printed p. 54; P5 Foundation p. 55; P4 Human System p. 53; Systems p. 52; P5 Plant System p. 57; Energy pp. 14, 78.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司《小学三至六年级科学教学大纲（标准 / 基础）》（2023 年小三学生起实施；封面注 2026 年 1 月更新）。人体系统（呼吸与循环系统），小五标准，印刷第 54 页；小五基础第 55 页；小四人体系统第 53 页；系统第 52 页；小五植物系统第 57 页；能量第 14、78 页。

note.en: Read in full (accessed 2026-10-21). P5 asks pupils to recognise that air is made up of gases such as nitrogen, carbon dioxide, oxygen and water vapour; to identify the nose, windpipe and lungs, and the heart, blood and blood vessels, and describe their functions; to recognise how the digestive, respiratory and circulatory systems work together in carrying out life processes; to compare how plants, fish and humans take in oxygen and give out carbon dioxide; and to compare transport in plants (tubes that carry food and water) and humans (blood vessels that carry digested food, oxygen and carbon dioxide). It says that alveoli, heart chambers and valves, and the terms xylem, phloem, stomata, artery, vein and capillary are not required. Heart rate, breathing rate, pulse, diaphragm, ribcage and gills do not appear in the syllabus. Releasing energy from food (respiration) is a P6 outcome and is not taught here.
note.zh: 已通读（2026-10-21 访问）。小五要求学生认识空气由氮气、二氧化碳、氧气、水蒸气等气体组成；认出鼻、气管、肺和心脏、血液、血管，并描述它们的功能；认识消化、呼吸、循环三个系统一起进行生命过程；比较植物、鱼和人怎样吸进氧气、放出二氧化碳；比较植物（运送食物和水的管）和人（运送消化后的食物、氧气和二氧化碳的血管）体内的运输。大纲写明不要求肺泡、心腔与瓣膜，也不要求使用木质部、韧皮部、气孔、动脉、静脉、毛细血管这些词。心率、呼吸频率、脉搏、膈、肋骨、鳃都不在大纲里。从食物中释放能量（呼吸作用）是小六的内容，这里不讲。

text.en: Betts J. G. et al. Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax, Rice University, 2022: §18.1 An Overview of Blood; §18.2 Production of the Formed Elements; §19.1 Heart Anatomy; §19.4 Cardiac Physiology; §20.2 Blood Flow, Blood Pressure, and Resistance; §20.5 Circulatory Pathways; §22.1 Organs and Structures of the Respiratory System; §22.2 The Lungs; §22.3 The Process of Breathing; §22.4 Gas Exchange; §23.5 The Small and Large Intestines.
text.zh: Betts J. G. 等《解剖学与生理学》第 2 版，OpenStax，莱斯大学，2022 年：第 18.1 节血液总览；第 18.2 节血细胞的生成；第 19.1 节心脏的解剖；第 19.4 节心脏生理；第 20.2 节血流、血压与阻力；第 20.5 节循环路径；第 22.1 节呼吸系统的器官与结构；第 22.2 节肺；第 22.3 节呼吸的过程；第 22.4 节气体交换；第 23.5 节小肠与大肠。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-22). The nose warms and humidifies air and removes debris and pathogens; the oropharynx is a passageway for both air and food and the routes divide below it; in swallowing the epiglottis closes the opening to the trachea; the trachea is 16 to 20 stacked C-shaped pieces of cartilage and divides into the right and left bronchi, which branch in the lungs (22.1). The right lung has three lobes, the left two; the left is smaller, with a cardiac notch for the heart (22.2). The lungs are passive in breathing: the diaphragm contracts and moves down, the external intercostals move the ribs up and out; some air (residual volume) always stays in the lungs; a child of about 10 breathes about 18 to 30 times a minute; rising carbon dioxide makes breathing faster and deeper (22.3). Atmospheric air 78.6 % nitrogen, 20.9 % oxygen, 0.04 % carbon dioxide; alveolar air 13.7 % oxygen, 5.2 % carbon dioxide, 6.2 % water vapour (22.4, tables 22.2 and 22.3). The heart lies between the lungs in the mediastinum, its apex just left of the sternum; about the size of a fist, 12 × 8 × 6 cm; a pump of cardiac muscle; about 70 mL per beat from each pumping chamber, 5.25 L a minute at rest in an adult; the pulmonary circuit takes blood to the lungs, where it picks up oxygen and gives up carbon dioxide, and the systemic circuit to the body; coronary arteries on its surface supply its own muscle (19.1). Activity raises heart rate and output; more carbon dioxide and less oxygen in the blood are detected and the heart speeds up (19.4). The pulse is usually taken at the radial artery in the wrist or the carotid artery in the neck (20.2). Blood from the stomach and intestines goes through the liver (hepatic portal system) before returning to the heart (20.5). Blood just oxygenated in the lungs is bright red, blood that has released oxygen a more dusky red; adult men have about 5 to 6 L, women 4 to 5 L; blood carries oxygen and nutrients to cells and removes wastes, and nutrients are absorbed in the digestive tract (18.1). All blood cells arise from stem cells in the red bone marrow (18.2). Most absorption of digested food takes place in the small intestine (23.5). Textbook licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; facts cited, no text or figures reproduced.
note.zh: 已读网页（2026-10-21、2026-10-22 访问）。鼻把空气加温、加湿，清除杂物和病菌；口咽是空气和食物共用的通道，到下面两条路分开；吞咽时会厌盖住气管的入口；气管由 16 到 20 块叠起来的 C 形软骨构成，分成左右支气管，在肺里一次次分支（22.1）。右肺三叶、左肺两叶，左肺较小，有心切迹给心脏留出空间（22.2）。呼吸时肺是被动的：膈收缩往下移，肋间外肌把肋骨往上、往外拉；肺里总留着一些空气（残气量）；十岁左右的孩子每分钟呼吸约 18 到 30 次；血里二氧化碳增多时，呼吸变快、变深（22.3）。大气：氮 78.6%、氧 20.9%、二氧化碳 0.04%；肺泡气：氧 13.7%、二氧化碳 5.2%、水蒸气 6.2%（22.4，表 22.2、22.3）。心脏在两肺之间的纵隔里，心尖在胸骨左边一点；约拳头大，12 × 8 × 6 厘米；由心肌构成的泵；成年人休息时每个主要泵血腔每跳约 70 毫升，每分钟 5.25 升；肺循环把血送到肺，血在那里得到氧气、交出二氧化碳，体循环把血送到全身；心脏表面的冠状动脉给心肌自己供血（19.1）。活动时心率与心输出量上升；血里二氧化碳增多、氧气减少被感受到后，心跳加快（19.4）。脉搏通常在手腕的桡动脉或脖子的颈动脉摸（20.2）。从胃和肠回来的血先经过肝（肝门静脉系统）再回心脏（20.5）。刚在肺里吸收了氧的血是鲜红色，送出氧之后是较暗的红色；成年男子约 5 到 6 升血，女子 4 到 5 升；血液把氧和养分送到细胞并带走废物，养分在消化道被吸收（18.1）。所有血细胞都来自红骨髓里的干细胞（18.2）。消化后的食物大部分在小肠被吸收（23.5）。教材许可：CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；引用事实，不复制文字或图。

text.en: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA). Earth Fact Sheet, Terrestrial Atmosphere: composition near the surface, by volume, dry air.
text.zh: 美国国家航空航天局空间科学数据协调档案馆（NSSDCA）《地球数据表》，地球大气：近地面的成分，按体积，干燥空气。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-21). Major: 78.08 % nitrogen, 20.95 % oxygen; minor: argon 9,340 ppm (0.934 %), carbon dioxide 420 ppm (0.042 %); water vapour highly variable, typically about 1 %. Rounded here to 78 %, 21 %, 0.04 % and about 1 %.

text.en: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory. Trends in Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide: monthly mean at Mauna Loa Observatory.
text.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局全球监测实验室《大气二氧化碳趋势》：莫纳罗亚观测站月平均值。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-21). September 2026: 426.07 ppm, about 0.04 % of air by volume (ppm ÷ 10,000). The value rises slowly from year to year.
note.zh: 已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。2026 年 9 月：426.07 ppm，按体积约占空气的 0.04%（ppm ÷ 10,000）。这个值每年缓慢上升。

text.en: Save My Exams. Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 revision notes, 11.1.4 Differences in inspired and expired air.
text.zh: Save My Exams《剑桥 IGCSE 生物 0610 复习笔记》第 11.1.4 节：吸入与呼出空气的差别。

note.en: Commercial revision notes, read online (accessed 2026-10-21). Inhaled air about 21 % oxygen, exhaled about 16 %; carbon dioxide 0.04 % → 4 %; nitrogen 78 % in both; water vapour higher in exhaled air. The school-table values; real breath has a little less nitrogen (S8).
note.zh: 商业复习资料，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。吸入空气约 21% 氧气，呼出约 16%；二氧化碳 0.04% → 4%；氮气两者都是 78%；呼出空气的水蒸气更多。这是课本表格的写法；实际呼出的气体里氮气略少（S8）。

text.en: LibreTexts Medicine. BIO 50 Anatomy and Physiology (Zingg, Las Positas College), 11.4 A Closer Look at the Air We Breathe.
text.zh: LibreTexts 医学《BIO 50 解剖学与生理学》（Zingg，拉斯波西塔斯学院）第 11.4 节：细看我们呼吸的空气。

note.en: College course page, read online (accessed 2026-10-21). Exhaled air has less oxygen, around 16 to 17 %, and about 4 to 4.4 % carbon dioxide; nitrogen about 78 % unchanged; exhaled air is saturated with water vapour.
note.zh: 大学课程页，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。呼出的气体氧气较少，约 16% 到 17%，二氧化碳约 4% 到 4.4%；氮气约 78% 不变；呼出的气体充满水蒸气。

text.en: Wikipedia. Breathing, section on the composition of inhaled and exhaled air.
text.zh: 维基百科（英文）“Breathing”条目，吸入与呼出空气成分一节。

note.en: Encyclopedia, read online (accessed 2026-10-21); used only for the range and for the rounding check. The volume of oxygen is reduced by about a quarter; exhaled air 13.6–16.0 % oxygen, 4.0–5.3 % carbon dioxide, 5.0–6.3 % water vapour. Our check: 16 ÷ 21 ≈ 0.76, so about three quarters of the oxygen is breathed out again.
note.zh: 百科，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）；只用来给范围和核对取整。氧气的体积减少约四分之一；呼出的气体氧气 13.6–16.0%、二氧化碳 4.0–5.3%、水蒸气 5.0–6.3%。我们的核算：16 ÷ 21 ≈ 0.76，所以大约四分之三的氧气又被呼出来。

text.en: Currie J. The Gas Exchange Page, table B: partial pressures of inspired, alveolar and expired air. East Tennessee State University.
text.zh: Currie J.《气体交换》网页，表 B：吸入、肺泡、呼出空气的分压。东田纳西州立大学。

note.en: University course page, read online (accessed 2026-10-21). Expired air: oxygen 116, carbon dioxide 29, nitrogen 568, water vapour 47 mm Hg of 760. Our arithmetic (mm Hg ÷ 760): about 15.3 % oxygen, 3.8 % carbon dioxide, 74.7 % nitrogen and 6.2 % water vapour. Used for the water vapour in breath (about 6 %) and for real breath having about 75 % nitrogen.
note.zh: 大学课程页，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。呼出空气：氧 116、二氧化碳 29、氮 568、水蒸气 47 毫米汞柱（共 760）。我们的换算（毫米汞柱 ÷ 760）：氧约 15.3%、二氧化碳 3.8%、氮 74.7%、水蒸气 6.2%。用于呼出气体里的水蒸气（约 6%），以及实际呼出气体里氮气约 75%。

text.en: Novak C., Gill P. Pediatric Vital Signs Reference Chart (PedsCases, 10 July 2018), reproducing the American Heart Association PALS guidelines (2015).
text.zh: Novak C.、Gill P.《儿科生命体征参考表》（PedsCases，2018 年 7 月 10 日），转载美国心脏协会儿科高级生命支持（PALS）指南（2015）。

note.en: Clinical teaching chart, read (accessed 2026-10-21). School age, 6 to 11 years: heart rate 75–118 beats a minute awake, 58–90 asleep; breathing 18–25 breaths a minute. Guideline ranges, not measurements of any one child; see the caution in S11.
note.zh: 临床教学表，已读（2026-10-21 访问）。学龄儿童（6 到 11 岁）：醒着时心跳每分钟 75–118 次，睡着时 58–90 次；呼吸每分钟 18–25 次。这是指南给的范围，不是某一个孩子的测量；另见 S11 的提醒。

text.en: Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials. Pushing a Child's Heart Rate High (with paediatric cardiologists R. Rao and K. Zahka).
text.zh: 克利夫兰诊所健康资讯《让孩子的心跳快起来》（儿科心脏科医生 R. Rao、K. Zahka）。

note.en: Hospital health page, read online (accessed 2026-10-21). School age (5 to 12 years): 75–118 beats a minute; the average maximum heart rate of active children aged 8 to 17 is typically in the mid-190s, and the formula 220 minus age overestimates it. The running value of the model (165) is about 85 % of that.
note.zh: 医院健康科普页，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。学龄（5 到 12 岁）：每分钟 75–118 次；8 到 17 岁好动的孩子，平均最大心跳通常在每分钟 190 多次，“220 减年龄”的公式会高估。模型里跑步的值（165）约是它的 85%。

text.en: Fleming S. et al. Normal ranges of heart rate and respiratory rate in children from birth to 18 years of age: a systematic review of observational studies. The Lancet 2011; 377 (9770): 1011–1018 (author manuscript PMC3789232).
text.zh: Fleming S. 等《从出生到 18 岁儿童心率与呼吸频率的正常范围：观察研究的系统综述》，《柳叶刀》2011 年第 377 卷第 9770 期，第 1011–1018 页（作者手稿 PMC3789232）。

note.en: Peer-reviewed, read online (accessed 2026-10-21): 69 studies of 143,346 children. The authors found that the common guideline ranges cite two textbooks that give no sources, and that one such cut-off classes about 40 % of healthy 10-year-olds as abnormal on heart rate and 63 % on breathing rate. Their centile tables are in a web appendix that could not be reached.
note.zh: 同行评审，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）：69 项研究，143,346 名儿童。作者发现，常用的指南范围引自两本没有给出来源的教科书；按其中一种界线，约 40% 健康的十岁孩子的心跳、63% 的呼吸会被判为不正常。他们的百分位表在网上附录里，没有读到。

text.en: Children's Health (Dallas). What is a normal heart rate for kids? (Colin Kane MD).
text.zh: 达拉斯儿童健康医院《孩子的正常心率是多少？》（Colin Kane 医生）。

note.en: Hospital health page, read online (accessed 2026-10-21): a child's heart rate can get much faster during exercise than an adult heart rate.
note.zh: 医院健康科普页，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）：运动时，孩子的心跳可以比成年人快得多。

text.en: Rowland T. W., Cunningham L. N. Development of ventilatory responses to exercise in normal white children: a longitudinal study. Chest 1997; 111 (2): 327–332.
text.zh: Rowland T. W.、Cunningham L. N.《正常白人儿童运动通气反应的发展：纵向研究》，《Chest》1997 年第 111 卷第 2 期，第 327–332 页。

note.en: Abstract read (accessed 2026-10-21). Children aged 9 to 13 followed for five years: at the same exercise load, breathing rate fell as they grew. The abstract gives no breaths-per-minute values, and no other source found gives breathing or heart rates of 10- to 12-year-olds right after walking or running; that is why the model's walking and running values are design values (S37).
note.zh: 只读摘要（2026-10-21 访问）。9 到 13 岁的孩子跟踪五年：同样的运动负荷下，呼吸频率随年龄下降。摘要里没有每分钟几次的数；我们找到的其他来源也都没有 10 到 12 岁孩子刚走完路、跑完步时的呼吸或心跳次数，所以模型里走路、跑步的值是设计值（S37）。

text.en: Geniebook. Primary 5 Science: Human Respiratory System; Human Circulatory System (tuition notes and practice questions).
text.zh: Geniebook《小五科学：人体呼吸系统；人体循环系统》（补习讲义与练习题）。

note.en: Commercial tuition site, read online (accessed 2026-10-21); used only to see how Singapore P5 practice material words the topic (rest, walk and run graphs; the respiratory system as nose, windpipe and lungs). Its phrase "release energy" belongs to P6 and is not used here.
note.zh: 商业补习网站，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）；只用来看新加坡小五练习材料怎样写这个课题（休息、走路、跑步的图；呼吸系统是鼻、气管和肺）。它用的“释放能量”属于小六内容，这里不用。

text.en: University of Iowa Health Care, Department of Anesthesia. Maximum Allowable Blood Loss (protocol), table of estimated blood volumes.
text.zh: 爱荷华大学医疗中心麻醉科《最大允许失血量》（诊疗规程），估算血量表。

note.en: Clinical protocol, read online (accessed 2026-10-21). Estimated blood volume: child 70–75 mL per kilogram of body weight (infant 70–80, adult 65–70).
note.zh: 临床规程，已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。估算血量：儿童每千克体重 70–75 毫升（婴儿 70–80，成人 65–70）。

text.en: World Health Organization. Growth reference data for 5–19 years (2007): weight-for-age, boys and girls, 5 to 10 years, row 10:0.
text.zh: 世界卫生组织《5–19 岁生长参考数据》（2007）：按年龄的体重，男孩与女孩，5 到 10 岁，10 岁 0 个月一行。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-21). Median weight at exactly 10 years: boys 31.2 kg, girls 31.9 kg (WHO reference population, not Singapore). Our rough estimate: 31.2 × 70 mL ≈ 2.2 L to 31.9 × 75 mL ≈ 2.4 L of blood (S16).
note.zh: 已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。满十岁时的体重中位数：男孩 31.2 千克、女孩 31.9 千克（世卫组织参考人群，不是新加坡）。我们的粗略估算：31.2 × 70 毫升 ≈ 2.2 升到 31.9 × 75 毫升 ≈ 2.4 升血（S16）。

text.en: I'm a Scientist, Get me out of here (UK). Question: How long does all your blood take to go all around your body? Answer by A. Hanvey, 20 March 2014.
text.zh: 英国“I'm a Scientist”科学家问答：全身的血绕身体一圈要多久？A. Hanvey 回答，2014 年 3 月 20 日。

note.en: Question-and-answer page (low weight), read online (accessed 2026-10-21): roughly about one minute, depending on the person. It agrees with our arithmetic from S2: 5 to 6 L of blood ÷ 5.25 L a minute ≈ 1 minute, for a resting adult. We found no value for children.
note.zh: 问答网页（分量较轻），已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）：大约一分钟，因人而异。这和我们用 S2 算的一致：5 到 6 升血 ÷ 每分钟 5.25 升 ≈ 1 分钟，指成年人休息时。没有找到孩子的值。

text.en: Kienle A. et al. Why do veins appear blue? A new look at an old question. Applied Optics 1996; 35 (7): 1151–1160.
text.zh: Kienle A. 等《静脉为什么看起来是蓝色的？对一个老问题的新看法》，《应用光学》1996 年第 35 卷第 7 期，第 1151–1160 页。

note.en: Peer-reviewed; abstract read (accessed 2026-10-21). The colour of blood vessels seen through skin depends on how skin scatters and absorbs light of different colours, on how much oxygen the blood carries, on the size and depth of the vessel, and on how our eyes judge colour. The blood itself is red.
note.zh: 同行评审；只读摘要（2026-10-21 访问）。隔着皮肤看到的血管颜色，取决于皮肤对不同颜色的光怎样散射和吸收、血里含多少氧、血管的粗细和深浅，以及我们的眼睛怎样判断颜色。血本身是红的。

text.en: Z-Anatomy, the open source atlas of anatomy (G. Kervyn, L. Vinent Juanico et al.), GitHub LluisV/Z-Anatomy, PC-Version branch, Resources/Models/FBX and License.txt; built on BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science.
text.zh: Z-Anatomy 开源解剖图谱（G. Kervyn、L. Vinent Juanico 等），GitHub LluisV/Z-Anatomy，PC-Version 分支，Resources/Models/FBX 与 License.txt；以生命科学数据库中心的 BodyParts3D 为基础。

note.en: Licence CC BY-SA 4.0, with the attribution lines "BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan" and "Z-Anatomy - The open source atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0". The meshes of this topic (airway, lungs, 28 air tubes, heart, the main blood vessels, diaphragm, 24 ribs and breastbone, five leg muscles on each side, skeleton, digestive organs, skin) are one adult male reference body, selected, simplified and renamed for Atlas (public/models/heart-and-lungs.glb; scripts/anatomy/heart-lungs/report.md). The glb and the geometry taken from it are CC BY-SA 4.0 (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).
note.zh: 许可 CC BY-SA 4.0，署名行为“BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan”和“Z-Anatomy - The open source atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0”。本主题的网格（气道、肺、28 段支气管、心脏、主要血管、膈、24 根肋骨和胸骨、每侧五块腿部肌肉、骨骼、消化器官、皮肤）取自同一个成年男性参考身体，为 Atlas 做了选取、简化和改名（public/models/heart-and-lungs.glb；scripts/anatomy/heart-lungs/report.md）。glb 及由它导出的几何为 CC BY-SA 4.0（THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md）。

text.en: Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS). BodyParts3D licence page.
text.zh: 生命科学数据库中心（DBCLS）BodyParts3D 许可说明页。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-21). BodyParts3D is now released under CC BY 4.0; Z-Anatomy states the older CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan. Material under CC BY may be included in a CC BY-SA work.
note.zh: 已读网页（2026-10-21 访问）。BodyParts3D 现按 CC BY 4.0 发布；Z-Anatomy 写的是较早的 CC BY-SA 2.1 日本。CC BY 的材料可以放进 CC BY-SA 的作品。

text.en: Atlas design study for this topic (docs/40): the model shows one adult male reference body, simplified, with only the main blood vessels, and a side table of teaching models (jar of air, fish, potted plant) not to scale. Design values: breathing in the model moves the lungs about 6 %, the diaphragm 2.5 cm and the ribs about 3 %, more than quiet breathing; the jar's balls are the typical per cents rounded to whole balls; the blood's round is six steps (heart to lungs, in the lungs, back to the heart, to the body, in the body, back to the heart). Model activity values: sitting at rest 20 breaths and 90 heartbeats a minute; walking 26 and 115; running 40 and 165. Display paces: blood × 1.0, 1.28, 1.83 (heartbeats ÷ 90); air × 1.0, 1.3, 2.0 (breaths ÷ 20); share of oxygen and carbon dioxide dots at the leg muscles 0.25, 0.5, 1.0. The heartbeat plays at heartbeats ÷ 60 per second and the breathing at breaths ÷ 60.
text.zh: 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（docs/40）：模型是一个成年男性参考身体，已简化，只画主要血管；旁边小桌上的教学模型（空气瓶、鱼、盆栽植物）不按比例。设计值：模型里呼吸时肺胀大约 6%、膈下移 2.5 厘米、肋骨外扩约 3%，都比平静呼吸明显；空气瓶的小球是典型百分比取整后的个数；血液的一圈分六步（心脏到肺、在肺里、回到心脏、到全身、在身体各处、回到心脏）。模型的活动值：坐着休息每分钟呼吸 20 次、心跳 90 次；走路 26 次和 115 次；跑步 40 次和 165 次。画面快慢：血流 × 1.0、1.28、1.83（心跳 ÷ 90）；气流 × 1.0、1.3、2.0（呼吸 ÷ 20）；腿部肌肉旁氧气和二氧化碳点的比例 0.25、0.5、1.0。心跳动画每秒跳 心跳 ÷ 60 次，呼吸动画每秒 呼吸 ÷ 60 次。

note.en: Not measurements. The resting values sit inside the guideline ranges for ages 6 to 11 (S9, S2); the walking and running values are chosen to show that breathing and heartbeat get faster, because no source found gives them for 10- to 12-year-olds (S14); the running heartbeat is below the mid-190s maximum reported for children (S10). Everyone is different. The blood paces show only that blood moves faster; how much more blood each beat pumps is not modelled. The paths of air and blood inside the nose, the heart, the lungs and the liver, and at the far ends of the vessels, are drawn, not traced in the meshes (scripts/anatomy/heart-lungs/routes.json marks them). Lengths quoted for this model (windpipe about 10.5 cm; lungs about 26 cm across and tall) are measured on the meshes.
note.zh: 不是测量值。休息时的值落在 6 到 11 岁的指南范围里（S9、S2）；走路、跑步的值是为了显示呼吸和心跳变快而取的，因为我们找到的来源都没有给出 10 到 12 岁孩子的这些值（S14）；跑步时的心跳低于报道的孩子平均最大心跳“190 多”（S10）。每个人都不一样。血流快慢只表示血流得更快；每跳一下多泵出多少血，模型没有算。空气和血在鼻腔、心脏、肺、肝里以及血管末端的路线是画出来的，不是在网格里描出来的（scripts/anatomy/heart-lungs/routes.json 标出了这些段）。本模型的长度（气管约 10.5 厘米；两肺约 26 厘米宽、26 厘米高）是在网格上量的。

text.en: Gray H. Anatomy of the Human Body. 20th edition, revised by W. H. Lewis. Lea & Febiger, 1918.
text.zh: Gray H.《人体解剖学》第 20 版，W. H. Lewis 修订，Lea & Febiger 出版，1918 年。

note.en: Public domain. Used, with S2, to decide which air tube each small branch of the model's airway belongs to where the source meshes leave a gap (scripts/anatomy/heart-lungs/report.md).
note.zh: 公有领域。和 S2 一起，用来判断模型气道里源网格留有空隙的几段小支气管各属于哪一条（scripts/anatomy/heart-lungs/report.md）。

text.en: Clark M. A., Douglas M., Choi J. Biology 2e. OpenStax, Rice University, 2018: §39.1 Systems of Gas Exchange; §29.1 Chordates; §29.2 Fishes.
text.zh: Clark M. A.、Douglas M.、Choi J.《生物学》第 2 版，OpenStax，莱斯大学，2018 年：第 39.1 节气体交换系统；第 29.1 节脊索动物；第 29.2 节鱼类。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-22). In the nasal cavity, hairs and mucus trap small particles, viruses, bacteria, dust and dirt; the human trachea is about 10 to 12 cm long and sits in front of the oesophagus (39.1). Fish have gills to take up the oxygen dissolved in water; gills are thin, highly branched and folded filaments with a large surface; as water flows over the gills, oxygen passes into the blood in their capillaries, and carbon dioxide passes from the blood into the water (39.1). Bony fishes breathe with gills in chambers covered by a protective flap, the operculum (29.2); in fishes the openings behind the mouth become the gills and let out the water that comes in through the mouth (29.1). The route mouth → over the gills → out under the gill cover puts 29.1 and 29.2 together; no single sentence states it for bony fishes. Licence CC BY 4.0.
note.zh: 已读网页（2026-10-22 访问）。鼻腔里的毛和黏液能粘住小颗粒、病毒、细菌、灰尘和污物；人的气管长约 10 到 12 厘米，在食道前面（39.1）。鱼用鳃吸收溶在水里的氧气；鳃是很薄、分支多、褶皱多的细丝，表面很大；水流过鳃时，氧气进入鳃里毛细血管中的血液，二氧化碳从血液进入水中（39.1）。硬骨鱼用鳃呼吸，鳃在一个由保护片（鳃盖）盖着的腔里（29.2）；鱼口后面的开口变成鳃，让从口进来的水流出去（29.1）。“从口进、流过鳃、从鳃盖下流出”是把 29.1 和 29.2 合起来说的；没有一句话直接这样写硬骨鱼。许可 CC BY 4.0。

text.en: Clark M. A., Douglas M., Choi J. Biology 2e. OpenStax, Rice University, 2018: §8.1 Overview of Photosynthesis; §30.2 Stems; §30.4 Leaves; §30.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants.
text.zh: Clark M. A.、Douglas M.、Choi J.《生物学》第 2 版，OpenStax，莱斯大学，2018 年：第 8.1 节光合作用总览；第 30.2 节茎；第 30.4 节叶；第 30.5 节植物体内水和溶质的运输。

note.en: Read online (accessed 2026-10-22). Gases are exchanged through small openings called stomata, typically on the underside of the leaf (8.1, 30.4); stomata let a plant take up carbon dioxide and release oxygen and water vapour (30.2) and must open for air with carbon dioxide and oxygen to reach the inside of the leaf, for photosynthesis and respiration (30.5). Photosynthesis uses light energy, carbon dioxide and water to make sugars and gives out oxygen (8.1). In the stem, xylem carries water and phloem carries sugars and other food (30.2). Licence CC BY 4.0. The same sections are cited by the plant topic.
note.zh: 已读网页（2026-10-22 访问）。气体经过叫作气孔的小开口进出，气孔通常在叶背（8.1、30.4）；气孔让植物吸进二氧化碳、放出氧气和水蒸气（30.2），含二氧化碳和氧气的空气要经过张开的气孔进入叶子里面，供光合作用和呼吸作用用（30.5）。光合作用利用光能、二氧化碳和水制造糖，并放出氧气（8.1）。在茎里，木质部运水，韧皮部运糖等食物（30.2）。许可 CC BY 4.0。植物主题引的也是这几节。

text.en: Virginia Cooperative Extension. Virginia Extension Gardener Handbook (2023), Chapter 1: Botany.
text.zh: 弗吉尼亚合作推广服务《弗吉尼亚推广园丁手册》（2023），第 1 章：植物学。

note.en: Extension handbook (CC BY-NC-SA). Used for: unlike photosynthesis, respiration in plants goes on at night as well as during the day, taking in oxygen and giving out carbon dioxide. The plant topic read this page and cites it for the same point; on 2026-10-22 the page refused automated access (HTTP 403), so it was not read again for this topic.
note.zh: 推广手册（CC BY-NC-SA）。用于：和光合作用不同，植物的呼吸作用白天和夜里都在进行，吸进氧气、放出二氧化碳。植物主题读过这一页，并为同一点引用它；2026-10-22 这一页拒绝自动访问（HTTP 403），所以本主题没有再读一遍。
